labels.criterion_text: Aged 18 - 70 years.
labels.reason: Patient was 51 years old at the reference date, within 18–70.

labels.criterion_text: Male or female.
labels.reason: Male or female participants are accepted; patient is documented as male.

labels.criterion_text: Eligible for bariatric surgery under the NHS.
labels.reason: Obesity and BMI 33.82 are documented, but NHS bariatric surgery eligibility has not been established.
missing_information: Obesity and BMI 33.82 are documented, but NHS bariatric surgery eligibility has not been established.

labels.criterion_text: Diagnosed with impaired glucose regulation or type 2 diabetes, according to WHO 2011 criteria.
labels.reason: Diabetes is diagnosed, but evidence that diagnosis followed WHO 2011 criteria is unavailable.
missing_information: Diabetes is diagnosed, but evidence that diagnosis followed WHO 2011 criteria is unavailable.
labels.review_notes: WHO 2011 qualifier requires explicit supporting evidence.

labels.criterion_text: Those with diabetes should be stable and well controlled with either diet or one oral hypoglycaemic agent.

missing_information: Metformin and serial HbA1c are documented, but stable well-controlled diabetes on diet or one oral agent is not fully established.

labels.criterion_text: HbA1c ≤9.0% or 74.9 mmol/mol.
labels.reason: Latest HbA1c was 6.95%, satisfying the stated maximum of 9.0%.

labels.criterion_text: History of any medical, psychological or other condition, or use of any medications, including over-the-counter products, which, in the opinion of the investigators, would either interfere with the study or potentially cause harm to the volunteer.
labels.reason: Clinical conditions exist, but no investigator assessment establishes interference with study safety or suitability.
missing_information: Clinical conditions exist, but no investigator assessment establishes interference with study safety or suitability.

labels.criterion_text: Without access at home to a telephone or other factor likely to interfere with ability to participate reliably in the study.

labels.criterion_text: Pregnancy or breastfeeding.

labels.criterion_text: Smokers.

labels.criterion_text: Any other co-morbidity that would compromise the validity of the study or the safety of the participant such as heart failure, clinically apparent cardiovascular disease.
